Closing date: Closing date not specified Job ref: JO0000030458 Location ref: Aberdeen Full Job Description Our client, a leading and well-established engineering contractor with a strong international presence, is currently seeking a QHSES Advisor to join their Aberdeen team on a permanent (staff) basis. Competitive salary and package available. ROLE The QHSES Advisor acts as a key advisor to management and operational teams, leading the implementation of QHSES programmes, monitoring business compliance and driving continual improvement across all aspects of quality, health, safety, environment and security. The role ensures operational risks are effectively managed, statutory and customer requirements are met, and a positive QHSES culture is embedded throughout Surface UK to support sustainable business performance and operational excellence. RESPONSIBILITIES Management System Compliance Support the implementation, maintenance and continual improvement of the Integrated QHSES Management System. Ensure compliance with company policies, customer requirements, industry standards and applicable legal obligations. Assist with maintaining certifications and registrations including ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and API Q2. Monitor changes in legislation, standards and customer requirements and communicate impacts to the business. Quality Assurance and Quality Control Support service, refurbishment, maintenance and project activities to ensure quality requirements are identified, planned and achieved. Develop, review and maintain Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), quality plans and supporting quality documentation. Manage non-conformances, customer complaints and quality incidents, including root cause analysis and corrective action verification. Facilitate customer, third-party and certification body audits and inspections. Monitor quality performance indicators and identify opportunities for continual improvement. Plan and conduct internal audits against company procedures, customer requirements and international standards. Track audit findings and verify completion of corrective actions. Support external audits conducted by customers, certification bodies and regulatory authorities. Provide assurance reporting to management on QHSES performance and compliance status. Health and Safety Provide advice and guidance to management, supervisors and employees on health and safety matters. Support risk assessments, COSHH assessments and safe systems of work. Assist with incident reporting, investigation, trend analysis and corrective actions. Promote occupational health initiatives including health surveillance programmes and wellbeing campaigns. Participate in emergency preparedness exercises and business continuity activities. Deliver QHSES inductions, awareness sessions and toolbox talks. Coach employees and supervisors on quality, safety, environmental and security requirements. Promote a positive reporting culture and employee engagement in QHSES initiatives. Support behavioural safety and continuous improvement programmes. Environmental Support compliance with environmental permits, waste management requirements and environmental procedures. Monitor environmental performance, objectives and targets. Assist with environmental inspections and audits. Promote waste reduction, pollution prevention and responsible resource usage initiatives. Investigate environmental incidents and support corrective actions where required. Security Promote compliance with site security req

ROLE Provides project management expertise to enable the successful delivery of the transition to the organisation, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards, while driving stakeholder engagement, business readiness, and the realisation of agreed strategic and operational benefits. Own the set-up of the organisation management system. Ensure relevant leavers are compliant with the company handover process. Maintain compliance with corporate management of change processes including reporting expectations. Escalate issues. Be a positive champion for change whilst remaining respectful of colleagues. Prepare and host readiness reviews at key milestones with a diverse range of team representatives and senior leaders. Any other associated duties as reasonably required. REQUIREMENTS Degree in engineering, energy, economics, business management or related discipline preferred but not essential. Postgraduate project management qualifications and/or professional accreditation preferred but not essential Familiar with project management fundamentals including planning, risk management and action tracking. Competent in MS Office Suite including Excel and Projects. Competence in Primavera P6 is preferred but not essential. Senior Drilling Engineer – Aberdeen | Market related | s1jobs Skip to main content Career Hub Companies & Insights Post a job Sign In Recruiters Upload your CV Sign In Recruiters Go to job search --> Senior Drilling Engineer CAMMACH BRYANT LIMITED, Aberdeen Senior Drilling Engineer Market related CAMMACH BRYANT LIMITED, Aberdeen Full time Contract Posted 1 day ago, 17 Aug | Get your application in today. Closing date: Closing date not specified Job ref: JO0000030441 Location ref: Aberdeen Full Job Description Our client, one of the UK’s largest independent oil and gas operators in the UK North Sea by production and resources, has a new requirement for an experienced Senior Drilling Engineer to join their team on an initial 12-month contract. Agency Worker / PAYE. ROLE The Senior Drilling Engineer will be responsible for supporting all aspects of Well Integrity, Well Construction, Well Intervention, Well Decommissioning and Well Abandonment projects. The role will cover the design, planning, execution and close-out of drilling and well activities, with responsibilities RESPONSIBILITIES Actively and significantly involved in the design, planning and execution of well operations safely, efficiently and cost effectively. Analyse offset data, generate and evaluate design options, assess risks, prepare detailed design and programme documents, prepare MOC's and dispensations to policy, prepare Examination and Notification/Consent applications, prepare time and cost estimates, procure services, equipment and materials and co-ordinate suppliers and service providers. Provide the rig team with technical, planning and operational support by co-ordinating the onshore internal and external team members to plan contingencies, resolve problems and execute rig operations safely, efficiently and cost effectively. Support the Well Integrity team on engineering reviews of well integrity issues of operating, suspended and long-term shut-in wells. Liaise & report with Regulatory and other external agencies, as required. Participate in changes and improvements to the Well Management System. Participate in Wells' duty rota and provide support to the Incident Management Team in the event of a rig-related incident. Prepare Basis of Design and Casing Design Documents. Preparing time and cost estimates and assist Drilling Accountant with cost tracking during well operations. Ensure the company standards for HES are rigorously applied to the well delivery and execution process and suggest improvements to the system. REQUIREMENTS University degree in relevant subject. Significant experience with Operator and/or Well Management company in the UK, with considerable experience at Drilling Engineer level (or above). Experience with the UK regulatory and permitting requirements, including preparation of OMAR Well Notifications and writing of well programmes in compliance with corporate policies, standards, procedures and guidelines. IWCF Surface and Subsea Well Control Level 4 BOSIET/FOET and Offshore Medical Certificates Direct job link https://www.s1jobs.com/job/senior-drilling-engineer-127215864 About this company CAMMACH BRYANT LIMITED View full company profile Discover Cammach: Leading UK energy recruitment firm offering dynamic careers, growth opportunities, and a supportive culture. board-workable-0d8cf31c6f74.description: We Are? We are EnerMech, a specialist service company that delivers safe, integrated solutions for complex energy projects. For over 50 years, we’ve been energizing our clients across the world with unrivalled expertise, equipment, and technology that supports the entire asset life-cycle – offshore and on land. We enable progress through our three global business lines: Energy Solutions, Infrastructure & Industrial Solutions, and Lifting Solutions. Within these areas, we offer a wide range of services, including cranes, lifting, fluid power, training, equipment rental, pipeline and subsea, process, and valves – all designed to help our clients optimize performance, enhance reliability, and improve efficiency. With a focus on operational excellence, we deliver value through our customized integrated solutions. This approach reduces risk and enhances efficiencies making us a leading and trusted partner every step of the way. Requirements The Role and Responsibilities EnerMech is gearing up for major shutdown campaigns across the country from August - end of November 2026. We are inviting expressions of interest from experienced and safety-driven Nitrogen Technicians to join our high-performing teams on upcoming projects. Regardless of your location we support point of hires from all major cities. Take on new challenges and put your skills to the test on diverse projects for leading oil and gas clients across Australia. Set up, operate, and monitor equipment for liquid nitrogen supply to support project operations. Safely handle cryogenic fluids, including liquid nitrogen (LN2), and operate LN2 vaporizers and pumps. Experience operating equipment for nitrogen / membrane units, gas separation technologies, and high‑volume nitrogen services. Conduct routine checks, maintenance, and monitoring to ensure equipment operates safely and efficiently. Work collaboratively with maintenance and operations teams to support continuous improvement and plant reliability. Uphold EnerMech’s strong commitment to safety, integrity, and operational excellence in every task. The Requirements 3–5 years' operating high-volume nitrogen membrane units. Familiarity with compressors, dryers and nitrogen membranes. Previous LNG facility or shutdown campaign experience (essential). Understanding of P&IDs, flow diagrams, and control systems. White Card Industry Safety Induction (desirable) Working at Heights, Confined Space dated within 2 years (desirable) Gast Test Atmosphere dated within 2 years (desirable) Ability to pass Safer Together Medical BOSIET - Offshore works mandatory Australian working rights Benefits Why EnerMech? Join a company that values its people, delivers high-quality projects, and prioritises safety and collaboration. You’ll gain exposure to challenging and varied projects while working with a supportive, skilled team. Take your career further — register your interest with EnerMech today!
